purpose: Additional stringent external-family validation, selected only from frozen input sequences and biological grouping, never model scores.
sequence_search: All unique chains >=20 residues as both queries and targets; MMseqs2 high sensitivity; >=30% identity, >=70% coverage of both sequences. Exact sequence matches explicitly included. Report heuristic search limits.
purge_rule: Connect records sharing long-chain sequence search edges, exact short peptides, or biological_system within a source. Remove every training record in a component connected to any of the 32 frozen external records. External cohort unchanged.
fits: Two additional from-scratch fits: full and intrachain; seed7, fixed epoch40, inherited architecture/optimizer/sampling, no test-driven selection. Single fitted model per arm, separate from fivefold ensemble.
matched_controls: Fit fixed 120-iteration 47-feature static sequence-complex and AA controls on the identical purged training records.
statistics: Report every external record; family dependence can make CI non-estimable; never pretend 32 related complexes are 32 independent protein families.
feasibility_rule: If fewer than 500 training records or fewer than 20 multichain training records remain, report the limitation and do not claim adequate strict multichain training; retain ordinary source-out evaluation.
